answer: Every claim climbs the nectar of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the umber re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. By the gale of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, slashed on a failed audit, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work.
